title: Turtle Beach Corporation Announces CFO Transition
summary: Andrew Clipsham Named Interim Chief Financial Officer Company Reaffirms Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance SAN DIEGO, May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Turtle Beach Corporation (Nasdaq: TBCH, the “Company” or “Turtle Beach”), a leading gaming accessories brand, today announced that Andrew Clipsham, Turtle Beach’s Senior Director of Finance, has been appointed interim Chief Financial Officer effective June 15, 2026. Clipsham will succeed Mark Weinswig as the Company has undertaken a search for a permanent Chief Financial Officer. Weinswig will stay with the Company through June 15 to ensure a seamless transition. Mr. Clipsham has led Turtle Beach’s international finance organization since 2019, overseeing the Company's financial operations including financial reporting, accounting operations, and internal controls.
